notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata collection requires an explicit Fetch details action rather than occurring automatically on save.
REF-BM-11: Tag filtering exists in the API and saved-view rules, but bookmark tags are not directly selectable as list filters.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and rendered as sanitized rich-text HTML, but Markdown syntax is not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape import preserves URLs, titles, and folder-derived tags, but ignores ADD_DATE and TAGS attributes.
REF-BM-32: Default sort and font size are configurable, but there is no displayed-item-count setting; density is provided instead.
